headline: Executive session on Assistant Principal candidate, resignations, and Business Manager's contract.
summary: The board will meet in executive session to discuss candidates for Assistant Principal at Moran Middle School, review resignation acceptances, and discuss the Business Manager's contract. Following the executive session, the board may take action on these three items.
items: Executive session: interviews and discussion of candidates for Assistant Principal Moran Middle School
Executive session: discussion of acceptance of resignation(s)
Executive session: discussion and review of the Business Manager's contract
Approval of appointment of candidate for Assistant Principal Moran Middle School
Possible action regarding the contract for the Business Manager
location: Board of Education Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Boulevard, Wallingford
